mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that drives wage growth and boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a monetary tightening that reduces economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in employment and wage growth signals a tight labor market that drives corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong employment and wage growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer spending signals a weak demand environment that reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).
